friends_policy: APK-aligned relation flow: send code 8/subcode 4, wait for the server-returned 8/4 acknowledgement, then request code 85 and ingest code 159 users[].rooms[].
ack_policy: No fixed 2.8s verification race. A friend job moves to ACKED only after an actual incoming server packet code 8/subcode 4; then 85 is requested and 159 is polled with bounded retries.
honour_policy: 10.21 Honour Probe rejected by live testing and removed from active launcher/catalog; no honour/admin spoofing or special-rank path is used.
cleanup_policy: 10.22 removes only 10.21 probe storage and identity-cache records explicitly marked probe1021; valid live-card and 159 identities are preserved.
rooms_policy: UI shows only nick and room locations. A server friend record with an empty rooms[] is treated as confirmed with no active room, not as a local-only fallback.
mix_policy: Confirmed 10.19 Color-aligned MIX 8/8 module is loaded unchanged.
launcher_policy: Stable and Beta remain separate; 10.22 is current beta, 10.20/10.19/10.18/10.17 remain rollbacks/baselines; 10.21 is removed.
